description: Arakawa-C grid for a tripolar ocean grid (1 deg in longitude; 0.25 deg in latitude near the equator, 1 deg at mid-latitudes; fold at 65N). Tracers are at h-points (g260), the zonal velocity at u-points on the east/west cell faces (g278), and the meridional velocity at v-points on the north/south cell faces (g270). The same grid is used by the ocean (MOM6) and sea ice (SIS2) components.
